verdicts.reason: Both use the same cramped five-column leaderboard. 'Ships late June' wraps into a stacked three-word orphan, the legal block is unreadably tiny and gets as much space as the CTA, and the small 'Reserve a Case' button is pushed into the far corner. In A, the headline nearly touches the top and bottom edges, and the sun mark sits awkwardly in the dark logo panel. B gives the headline a little more breathing room and centres the logo better, but its body copy is almost as heavy as the headline and runs close to the top edge, so the two compete for attention.
